_comment: P2 merged constraints for usb-buck (research/interface-usb.json + research/power.json). CANONICAL net names, verified against the schlib hierarchy semantics: power symbols are global and bare (VBUS, +3V3, GND), root-crossed signals are /NAME, sheet-internal signals are /<sheet>/NAME - see architecture/sheets.md s1. Stackup is JLC04161H-3313, so the diff_90 geometry (w 0.314, gap 0.210 edge-to-edge, 0.52 centre-to-centre) from the research fragment carries over verbatim. Absent keys are deliberate no-ops: voltages (max on-board potential is 5 V, nothing near the 30 V creepage trigger), thermal (worst dissipation 0.165 W in U1, 0.031 W in U2 - nothing near 0.5 W), planes (the 4-layer default In1=GND + In2=dominant power already resolves to In2=+3V3; see stackup.md).
